rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityOther
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to related security information of unspecified type.
Defines the original host file that the snippet information applies to.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: build
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM generated as part of the process of building the software to create a releasable artifact (e.g., executable or package) from data such as source files, dependencies, built components, build process ephemeral data, and other SBOMs.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/Security/VulnAssessmentRelationship is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: analysis
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Analytical evaluating of data, designs, or processes methodically to verify correctness against standards or expectations. Typical analysis methods are FMEA, FTA, STPA, static analysis for MISRA compliance etc.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: incomplete
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relationship is known not to be exhaustive.
responsibilityCategory classifies the nature or domain of a responsibility transfer.
Provides the result of an export control assessment.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: dataset
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Dataset profile specification.
A reference to a resource outside the scope of SPDX 3 content related to an Element.
Refers to any unit of content that can be associated with a distribution of software.
A specification is a detailed description of the design, requirements, or features of a product, process, or system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: no
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Indicates absence of the field.
A text describing the design constraint defined by the assumption.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDynamicLink
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element dynamically links in each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.
Class that describes an instance of Hardware.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityPenTestReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a [penetration test](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Penetration_test) report for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: critical
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: When a CVSS score is between 9.0 - 10.0.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fail
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Indicates a failed evaluation where the requirement or condition is not met.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element doesn't fit into any of the other categories.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: dependsOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element depends on each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: mavenCentral
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Maven repository artifact. The artifact locator format is defined in the [Maven documentation](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-naming-conventions.html) and looks like `groupId:artifactId[:version]`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: packageUrl
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Package-URL (PURL), as defined in [ECMA-427](https://ecma-international.org/publications-and-standards/standards/ecma-427/).
Specifies a country code where a software service is hosted.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDataFile
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element treats each `to` Element as a data file. A data file is an artifact that stores data required or optional for the `from` Element's functionality. The `hasDataFile` relationship does not imply a dependency. Examples of data files include database files, index files, log files, AI model files, calibration data files, temporary files, and backup files. For configuration data, build input data, build output data, test artifacts, test datasets, and training datasets, the more specific relationship types `configures`, `hasInput`, `hasOutput`, `hasTest`, `testedOn`, and `trainedOn` shall be used, respectively.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: scrapingScript
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset provider is not making available the underlying data and the dataset shall be reassembled, typically using the provided script for scraping the data.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isil
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Identifier for Libraries and Related Organizations (ISIL)](https://slks.dk/english/work-areas/libraries-and-literature/library-standards/isil/) is a unique alphanumeric code for identifying libraries, archives, museums, and related organizations standardized by [ISO 15511](https://www.iso.org/standard/77849.html). It consists of a prefix—which may be an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code or a non-country code assigned by the ISIL Registration Authority—followed by a unit identifier, totaling up to 16 characters (e.g., `FI-Sipoo-Sö` or `ZDB-1-SBD`). Valid symbols include any alphanumeric character, solidus (`/`), hyphen-minus (`-`), or colon.
This is the planned individual, business, or organization who was previously managing goods, services, or assets.
Abstract ancestor class for all VEX relationships.

**DEPRECATED in SPDX 3.1.** Use [/Core/intendedUse](../../Core/Properties/intendedUse.md) instead.
The intended use of a given dataset.
Identifies the full text of a License, in SPDX templating format.
Specifies whether a license or additional text identifier has been marked as deprecated.
ResponsibilityChangeAction refers to the transfer of responsibility from one party to another.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/Core/DefinedProcess is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cpe22
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Common Platform Enumeration Specification 2.2](https://cpe.mitre.org/files/cpe-specification_2.2.pdf).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: blake2b256
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: BLAKE2b algorithm with a digest size of 256, as defined in [RFC 7693](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc7693/) Section 4.
Specifies the CVSS qualitative severity rating of a vulnerability in relation to a piece of software.
Class that describes a physical instance of Hardware.
Mechanism to update the dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: eolNotice
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the End Of Sale (EOS) and/or End Of Life (EOL) information related to a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fullAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 5 - Full automation. The system is capable of performing its entire mission without external intervention.
Class that describes a process.
Provides an exploit assessment of a vulnerability.
Timestamp of impact statement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: crystalsDilithium
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Dilithium](https://pq-crystals.org/dilithium/)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nli
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Natural Location Identifier (NLI)](https://eccma.org/enli-eccma-natural-location-identifier/) is a 14- or 15-character alphanumeric string standardized by [ISO 8000-118](https://www.iso.org/standard/85428.html) that uniquely identifies a three-dimensional geographic point location. The identifier is generated from geodetic coordinates and elevation data. For electronic storage, the `ISO.NLI:` prefix shall be retained (e.g., `ISO.NLI:41TS8M-A8ELTQ-H2`).
Specifies the type of simulation model used to represent virtual hardware.
Provides a CVSS version 2.0 assessment for a vulnerability.
Points to a resource outside the scope of the SPDX 3 content that provides additional characteristics of an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: doesNotAffect
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Security/Vulnerability has no impact on each `to` Element. The use of the `doesNotAffect` is constrained to `/Security/VexNotAffectedVulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: componentAnalysisReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Software Composition Analysis (SCA) report.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: backlog
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A requirement has been captured and logged, but not yet ready to become a formal requirement draft. A backlog requirement may still be incomplete or ambiguous.
Abstract class for the portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing a license.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasOutput
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Build/Build, DefinedProcess or Action element generates each `to` Element as an output.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: clear
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Unlimited. Subject to standard copyright rules, the dataset may be shared freely, without restriction.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: email
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Email address, as defined in [RFC 3696](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3696/) Section 3.
Type of the model used in the AI software.
Identifies the text of one or more copyright notices for a software Package, File or Snippet, if any.
Specifies the licenseId that is preferred to be used in place of a deprecated License or LicenseAddition.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: assistiveAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 1 - Assistive automation. The system assists an operator.
The boundary definition is used to define boundaries.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityOther
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used when there is a security related identifier of unspecified type.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: secureSoftwareAttestation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to information assuring that the software is developed using security practices as defined by [NIST SP 800-218 Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) Version 1.1](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/218/final) or [CISA Secure Software Development Attestation Form](https://www.cisa.gov/resources-tools/resources/secure-software-development-attestation-form).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: file
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a single file which can be independently distributed (configuration file, statically linked binary, Kubernetes deployment, etc.).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: kev
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerability (KEV) catalog.
A collection of SPDX Elements that could potentially be serialized.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cwe
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Common Weakness Enumeration](https://csrc.nist.gov/glossary/term/common_weakness_enumeration). A reference to a source of software flaws defined within the official [CWE List](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/) that conforms to the [CWE specification](https://cwe.mitre.org/).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is related to the `from` Element where the relationship type is not described by any of the SPDX relationship types (this relationship is directionless).
A map of Element identifiers that are used within an SpdxDocument but defined external to that SpdxDocument.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runsOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element (the instructions) runs on each `to` /Hardware/Hardware (processing element), during a LifecycleScopeType period.
Identifies the name of an Element as designated by the creator.
Provides additional purpose information of the software artifact.
Provides advise on how to mitigate or remediate a vulnerability when a VEX product is affected by it.
A Role defines a specific position, function, or capacity that an entity may assume within any relevant context.
Results of general safety risk assessment of the AI system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: socialMedia
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a social media channel for a package.
Refers to any object that stores content on a computer.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: altWebPage
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an alternative web page.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: tracedToDetail
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Requirement is refined and further elaborated by each `to` Requirement, which contains more detailed implementation information.
Connects a vulnerability and an element designating the element as a product affected by the vulnerability.
RoleRelationship represents a relationship between an entity holding a role and the scope or context in which that role applies. The givenRole property specifies the role assigned.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: lei
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The [Legal Entity Identifier (LEI)](https://www.gleif.org/en/organizational-identity/introducing-the-legal-entity-identifier-lei) is a 20-character, alphanumeric code based on the [ISO 17442](https://www.iso.org/standard/78829.html) standard developed by the International Organization for Standardization.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: delegatedTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Agent is delegating an action to the Agent of the `to` Relationship (which shall be of type invokedBy), during a LifecycleScopeType period (e.g. the `to` invokedBy Relationship is being done on behalf of `from`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cve
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures identifiers, an identifier for a specific software flaw defined within the official CVE Dictionary and that conforms to the [CVE specification](https://csrc.nist.gov/glossary/term/cve_id).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: container
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a container image which can be used by a container runtime application.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used to store extra information about an Element which is not part of a review (e.g. extra information provided during the creation of the Element).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: text
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data consists of unstructured text, such as a book, a Wikipedia article (without images), or a transcript.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: highAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 4 - High automation. The system performs parts of its mission without external intervention.
A distinct article or unit related to Software.
A Package that contains AI software or an AI model.
A license that is listed on the SPDX License List.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: doi
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Digital Object Identifier (DOI)](https://www.doi.org/the-identifier/what-is-a-doi/) is a unique, [ISO 26324](https://www.iso.org/standard/88862.html)-standardized identifier for physical, digital, or abstract objects, formatted as a prefix and suffix separated by a forward slash (e.g., `10.1000/182`).
A value used in a generic key-value pair.
Denote whether a CVE is present in an exploit catalog.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: affects
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Security/Vulnerability, Action or DefinedProcess affects each `to` Element.
Sponsor of the project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: underInvestigationFor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Security/Vulnerability impact is being investigated for each `to` Element. The use of the `underInvestigationFor` type is constrained to `/Security/VexUnderInvestigationVulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: megajoule
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Megajoule.
Limitation of the AI software.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: swid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Concise Software Identification (CoSWID) tag, as defined in [RFC 9393](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc9393/) Section 2.3.
Describes the type of annotation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: purchaseOrder
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a purchase order for a package.
A prescribed change to a product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bom
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a bill of materials related to a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha384
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-2 with a digest length of 384, as defined in [RFC 6234](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc6234/).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: pass
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Indicates a successful evaluation where the requirement or condition is clearly met.
A statement of how, or for what purpose, an item or artifact is intended to be used.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: chat
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the instant messaging system used by the maintainer for a package.
A string in the license expression format.
An SPDX Element containing an SPDX license expression string.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: timestamp
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is recorded with a timestamp for each entry, but not necessarily ordered or at specific intervals, such as when a taxi ride starts and ends.
Availability of dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: noAssertion
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: No assertion about the type of support is made. This is considered the default if no other support type is used.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: orcidid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Open Researcher and Contributor ID (ORCID) iD](https://info.orcid.org/what-is-orcid/) is a unique identifier for authors and contributors in scholarly communication; as a subset of the International Standard Name Identifier (ISNI), it typically appears as a URI such as `https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1825-0097`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: productMetadata
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to additional product metadata such as a reference within an organization's product catalog.
Property describing the session in which a build is invoked.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: design
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during an element's design.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: exploitCreatedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Security/Vulnerability has had an exploit created against it by each `to` Agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: documentation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is documentation.
Base domain class from which all other SPDX 3 domain classes derive.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fixedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` /Security/Vulnerability has been fixed by the `to` Agent(s).
A textual expression describing the actual need defined by the requirement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: iswc
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Musical Work Code (ISWC)](https://www.iswc.org/iswc) is an 11-character unique identifier standardized by [ISO 15707](https://www.iso.org/standard/83125.html) for musical works (compositions) as distinct from specific recordings. While the "ISWC" label and grouping separators (dots and hyphens) are used for human readability, they shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `T0017812031`).
Portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing a License which has additional text applied to it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ai
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the AI profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: generates
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element generates each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: publishedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` /Security/Vulnerability was made available for public use or reference by each `to` Agent.
Provides a map of a property name to a value.
Provides the location of an exploit catalog.
An Organization representing the SPDX Project.
This individual element was defined by the spec.
A reference to a resource identifier defined outside the scope of SPDX 3 content that uniquely identifies an Element.
A collection of Elements that have a shared context.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: blake2b384
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: BLAKE2b algorithm with a digest size of 384, as defined in [RFC 7693](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc7693/) Section 4.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cpe23
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Common Platform Enumeration: Naming Specification Version 2.3](https://csrc.nist.gov/publications/detail/nistir/7695/final).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: high
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: When a CVSS score is between 7.0 - 8.9.
Describes the specific responsibility of a Role.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: medium
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: When a CVSS score is between 4.0 - 6.9.
Energy consumption incurred by an AI model.
Information related to hardware dimension.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: glue
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [GLobal Unique Enterprise (GLUE) Identifiers](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-ietf-spice-glue-id/), as defined by the IETF Internet-Draft, is expressed as a GLUE URI, a Uniform Resource Identifier that standardizes the representation of existing organizational entity identifiers.

referenceSpecification provides a reference to a DefinedType that defines the specific meaning, structure, and semantics of a Role. It connects the role to its authoritative source definition, ensuring consistent interpretation across different contexts.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha224
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-2 with a digest length of 224, as defined in [RFC 3874](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3874/).
Threshold that was used for computation of a metric described in the metric field.
Specifies a vulnerability and its associated information.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: supplyChain
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the SupplyChain profile specification.
Links a vulnerability and one or more elements designating the latter as products not affected by the vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inspection
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A thorough examination or checking of documentation, records, processes, or systems to confirm compliance or adherence. An inspection needs to have a defined set of acceptance criteria (e.g. a checklist), a documentation of roles involved in the inspection (e.g. to document the inspector's independence) and a clear documentation of when and how it was performed.
A location of the organization's headquarters.
Specifies the value of the content identifier.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: md5
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: MD5 message-digest algorithm, as defined in [RFC 1321](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc1321/).
Defines the level of automation a system possesses.
A place for the SPDX document creator to record a website that serves as the package's home page.
An assertion made in relation to one or more elements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: republishedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` /Security/Vulnerability's details were tracked, aggregated, and/or enriched to improve context (i.e. NVD) by each `to` Agent.
Provides information about the creation of the Element.
Gives information about the circumstances or unifying properties that Elements of the bundle have been assembled under.
Specifies whether an additional text identifier has been marked as deprecated.
A canonical, unique, immutable identifier of the artifact content, that may be used for verifying its identity and/or integrity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: assessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A systematic examination of a system, process, or outcome to evaluate compliance of specific work products with a specific expectation with a specification, regulation or standard. Often involves judgement and a rationale of this judgement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: library
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a software library.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: createdBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Action or DefinedProcess is createdBy `to` Agent(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: module
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a module of a piece of software.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: evidenceUID
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The unique identifier used by a reporting management system or any other lifecycle management tool to uniquely identify an evidence relationship item.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sensor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is recorded from a physical sensor, such as a thermometer reading or biometric device.
A container for a grouping of SPDX 3 content characterizing details (provenance, composition, licensing, etc.) about a product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inconclusive
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Inconclusive refers to a result or outcome from a verification, test, or analysis that cannot be clearly classified as either positive (successful, pass) or negative (failed, reject). An inconclusive result means there was not enough clear evidence, data, or signal to make a definitive determination, and further investigation or additional testing is necessary. An inconclusive result always shall need a comment on it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An authentication protocol not covered by one of the other AuthenticationProtocolTypes.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: crl
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Certificate Revocation List, or CRL, is a list of revoked certificates that is downloaded from the Certificate Authority (CA).
Provides information about the content type of an Element or a property.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: implementedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Requirement is implemented in the `to` Element(s).
Describes a certain part of a file.
A Package that contains a dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasConcludedLicense
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Artifact is concluded by the SPDX data creator to be governed by each `to` /SimpleLicensing/AnyLicenseInfo. If the `to` of an Artifact's `hasConcludedLicense` is not the same as the `to` of its `hasDeclaredLicense`, a written explanation should be provided in the comment field of the `hasConcludedLicense` relationship.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: invokedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element was invoked by the `to` Agent, during a LifecycleScopeType period (for example, a /Build/Build element that describes a build step).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: staticAnalysisReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a static analysis report for a package.
A mapping between prefixes and namespace partial URIs.
Title of the project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: certificationReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a certification report for a package from an accredited/independent body.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasAssociatedVulnerability
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used to associate a `from` Artifact with each `to` /Security/Vulnerability.
Specifies an Extension characterization of some aspect of an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isni
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Name Identifier (ISNI)](https://isni.org/page/what-is-isni/) is a unique identifier used to distinguish the public identities of parties involved in the creation, production, and distribution of media content. Standardized by [ISO 27729](https://www.iso.org/standard/87177.html), it consists of 16 characters—15 digits plus a final check character—and is often represented as a URI, such as `https://isni.org/isni/000000012146438X`.
Information related to hardware dimension.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: blake3
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [BLAKE3](https://github.com/BLAKE3-team/BLAKE3-specs/blob/master/blake3.pdf)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: contains
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element contains each `to` Element.
A distinct article or unit within the domain.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Any other specialized or custom verification method that fits the context.
EvidenceRelationship defines the association between pieces of evidence and EvaluationResult.
Property describes the invocation entrypoint of a build.
Explains why a VEX product is not affected by a vulnerability. It is an alternative in VexNotAffectedVulnAssessmentRelationship to the machine-readable justification label.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: conformsTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element conforms to each `to` /FunctionalSafety/Assumption or Specification.
Date of product release.
Location is used to define the location, address or coordinates of a place.
Records any relevant background information or additional comments about the origin of the package.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/SupplyChain/CreateAction is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment:
**DEPRECATED in SPDX 3.1.** Use [customIdToLicense](./customIdToLicense.md) instead.
Maps a "LicenseRef-" string for a custom license or a "AdditionRef-" string for a custom license addition to its URI identifier.
**NOTE:** This property is deprecated and only included for backward compatibility. New documents should use [customIdToLicense](./customIdToLicense.md) instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: blake2b512
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: BLAKE2b algorithm with a digest size of 512, as defined in [RFC 7693](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc7693/) Section 4.
The amount or measure of a bulk product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: lexid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: LEX Identifier is a Uniform Resource Name (URN) for sources of law within the [LEX namespace](https://www.iana.org/assignments/urn-formal/lex), as defined in [RFC 9676](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc9676/) (e.g., `urn:lex:it:stato:decreto.legislativo:2018-08-10;101`).
evidenceCategory refers to a category of documented or observable proof.
A probability score between 0 and 1 of a vulnerability being exploited.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: data
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is data.
Identifies all the text and metadata associated with a license in the license XML format.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: metrics
